goal: Make a defensible one-shot training decision without allowing a future candidate to define the preservation criteria used to judge itself.
procedure: Freeze ordinary and endpoint preservation metrics from repeated canonical-parent evaluation only. Use a fixed pre-candidate numerical rule atol=max(1e-6,2*max_pairwise_abs_repeat_delta), rtol=0. Require that calibration to pass before any optimizer or GPU run. Authorize at most one bounded interface-only experiment whose trainable scope is the relation-conditioned multi-layer query interface plus a zero-initialized signed endpoint readout on top of an immutable parent graph.
decision_criteria: parent-only calibration pass is prerequisite for gradient execution
causal dev improvement must include causes and supports
no test or frozen challenge used for checkpoint selection
authority: May define the pre-candidate preservation policy and one bounded experimental training path. Does not itself authorize heldout opening, scaling, private identity gradient, promotion, or N0 completion.
validation: GitHub Actions run 35419300501 passed the complete static contract suite. Earlier CI failures were assertion-string mismatches and are not model evidence.
failure_or_lesson: Preservation criteria must be fixed independently of the candidate. A new causal architecture can be tested without replay-gradient contamination by keeping preservation lanes evaluation-only and requiring exact-parent initialization plus parent-only calibrated gates.
notes: The bounded experiment budget is diagnostic, not a permanent model ceiling. Failure should reopen the language-graph boundary instead of spawning local hotfixes.
